Hi Priya,

Looking forward to our office hours today at 10:00 AM PT (Google Meet link is in the invite). To make the session useful for your engineering team, can you confirm two quick items before we start?

- Do you have a trial API key generated in the Redwood console? (If not, I can walk you through provisioning.)
- Which SDK are you planning to use — Python (pip) or Node (npm)? Let me know the version if you already installed it.

If you can drop the API key status in a reply, I can prep a short diagnostic checklist so we don't spend the first 15 minutes on access. I attached a one-page quickstart that covers SDK install + sample requests.

If anything changes on timing, give me a heads up and we can shift the slot.

Thanks,

Hi Priya —

We missed you for the 10:00 slot; I waited on the call for ~15 minutes in case you ran late. No worries if something came up. Would you like to rebook a 30-minute reconnect this week?

Suggested times (PT):
- Wed 7/29 11:00–11:30
- Thu 7/30 09:00–09:30
- Fri 7/31 14:00–14:30

If the issue is the trial API key not being available, a quick note: the common reasons are (1) the trial account email mismatch, (2) invite not accepted, or (3) permission scope not granted. If you can share the error message (screenshot is fine), I can triage before we meet.

If you'd prefer, loop in your engineer and I can send a short checklist for them to run (SDK pip/npm install, set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, test /v1/health).

—Connor

Thanks for the update, Priya & Alex — glad we have a slot that works. I'll tentatively book Wed 2026-07-29 11:00 PT per your note, but since there's a conflict window I want to confirm: do you prefer Wed 7/29 11:00 PT (preferred) or Fri 7/31 14:00 PT (backup)? Reply with the preferred slot and I'll send the invite.

Quick troubleshooting notes I pushed to the thread (will save time on the call):
1) Trial activation: "Pending activation" usually means the org invite wasn't accepted by the account owner email. If you can forward the invitation acceptance email or confirm the account email for the trial (which user clicked the invite), we can escalate to provisioning. I opened a support ticket on our side (HS-4261) and can include any logs you share.

2) SDK on M1 (Python): try installing with the wheel for arm64 or run: python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools && pip install redwood-sdk --no-binary :all: then set REDWOOD_API_KEY in your env and test the health endpoint: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health

3) If Alex can run the sample script, please include the exact pip/npm error output — that will help us avoid spending the call on install.

I'll attach a short step-by-step for SDK install and a redo of the quickstart (attached). If you confirm Wed 7/29 11:00 PT I will send an invite to all included.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: sdk-install-steps.txt, redwood-trial-quickstart.pdf
